observation_summary: An IllegalArgumentException is thrown because an infinite value is passed as the 'initial' parameter to the bracket method.
reasoning_summary: The bug is caused by an invalid calculation in the 'getInitialDomain' method of 'FDistributionImpl'. When the denominator degrees of freedom is exactly 2.0, the formula 'd / (d - 2.0)' results in a division by zero, producing 'Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY'. This infinite value is subsequently passed to 'UnivariateRealSolverUtils.bracket', which expects a finite value within the specified bounds, triggering an 'IllegalArgumentException'. The fix introduces a conditional check to ensure the formula is only applied when the denominator degrees of freedom is greater than 2.0, defaulting to 1.0 otherwise.
